text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black deep-V long-sleeve blouse and flowing black wide-leg tailored trousers, black pointed heels. No detachable scarf or corset belt.
original_prompt: Edit this white-background hollow outfit product photo. Remove the black neck scarf entirely: leave a clean empty deep V neckline with no strip spanning the neck. Remove the detachable wide corset waist belt; show the plain blouse tucked into the trousers with natural folds. Preserve the same black long-sleeve blouse, wide-leg trousers and pointed shoes. No skin, body, mannequin or new accessories. Pure white background, fully uncropped, portrait 2:3.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
